searchText: I'm looking at this now - I don't remember though where we landed in our discussion on slot vs block number - slot is easier (for future compatibility, given that's how the protocol is structured on the CL side) but EL:s might not be able to perform the mapping Here is the beginning of the most recent discussion: https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/892088344438255616/954362244861423666 Another related thing: https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/892088344438255616/961948735577935932 I think you should put these thoughts into comments to the issue or PR in Engine API repo, so we won't be looking for them every time when touching this topic indeed, this was what I was referring to - "may", but hasn't yet, right? Right, and we don't know yet when this change will be rolled out. For instance, recent withdrawals design doesn't depend on it (one of the previous designs did) Do you know which blocknumbers those are ? there's a similar argument to be made for beacon block roots vs execution block roots something like this: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/218 cc <@425572898787426305> <@602753420033785856> <@755590043632140352> You can check it on prysm<>nethermind node and see docker logs from nethermind. If you don't have access, <@199561711278227457> could probably set it for you sg, will wait for parithosh to reply then I dont think i have access to the prysm-nethermind box Actually nvm , I do. The reason prysm might be spamming those requests is because prysm is also stuck syncing for some reason Configs for `mainnet-shadow-fork-4` are now out: https://github.com/eth-clients/merge-testnets/tree/main/mainnet-shadow-fork-4 I know we barely got done with msf3 and there might still be things we find, But I just wanted to release the configs early so that there's enough time to sync nodes. I'll reach out about client updates mid next week 🙂 TTD is aimed for thursday ~4PM. We'd aim for a TTD ovveride on wednesday to keep things on track. Tooling links(nodes are still syncing): https://ethstats.mainnetshadowfork4.ethdevops.io/ https://beaconchain.mainnetshadowfork4.ethdevops.io/ https://explorer.mainnetshadowfork4.ethdevops.io/ In order to collect more information, we were thinking of having a small `goerli-shadow-fork-5` next week as well. The idea is to try shadow merging gsf5 with pyrmont (which is deprecated). Since only the EF validators (~20%) of the network will join this shadow fork, we should theoretically inactivity leak the other 80% until we are able to finalize. That way we have EL and CL state and can reasonably test genesis sync on both sides. No idea how well this will work, but the idea is to just try it out. I will reuse the client versions from msf4 so there shouldn't be any increased load for client teams. More info on monday 🙂

Since only the EF validators (~20%) of the network will join this shadow fork, we should theoretically inactivity leak the other 80% until we are able to finalize. That way we have EL and CL state and can reasonably test genesis sync on both sides. No idea how well this will work, but the idea is to just try it out. I will reuse the client versions from msf4 so there shouldn't be any increased load for client teams. More info on monday 🙂
